title: Jishou Akuyaku Reijou na Konyakusha no Kansatsu Kiroku.
synopsis: Cecil Glo Alphasta's life is always utterly unchallenging. The heir to his father's kingdom, he is known as a genius in everything he accomplishes. However, nothing interests him until he meets his fi...
synopsis_es:
La vida de Cecil Glo Alphasta siempre es absolutamente tranquila. Heredero del reino de su padre, es conocido como un genio en todo lo que logra. Sin embargo, nada le interesa hasta que conoce a su prometida, Bertia Ibil Noches.

En su primer encuentro, Bertia le dice que están dentro de un juego otome y que ella tiene el papel de la villana que interfiere con la relación entre Cecil y la heroína. Aunque proclama que cumplirá con su deber de "flor malvada", las acciones de Bertia terminan causando más bien que mal. Intrigado por su comportamiento y sus acciones, Cecil decide que quiere a Bertia cerca y la ayuda detrás de escena. Pero con una prometida como Bertia, es posible que la heroína ya no sea necesaria.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]
background: Jishou Akuyaku Reijou na Konyakusha no Kansatsu Kiroku. was released on Blu-ray and DVD in a box set on August 28, 2026.

episodes_data.title: An Observation Log of Meeting a Self-Proclaimed Villainess.
episodes_data.description: When Crown Prince Cecil is ten years old, he takes Bertia as his fiancée. She claims to have memories of her past life, and says that this is the world of an otome game she once played. She also says that she is a villainess. Cecil is generally bored, but her extraordinary statements spark curiosity in his heart.
episodes_data.title_es: Un registro de observación del encuentro con una autoproclamada villana.

episodes_data.title: An Observation Log of the Self-Proclaimed Villainess's Debut into Society.
episodes_data.description: Bertia struggles to correct the scenario she has unintentionally altered. At the same time, Cecil enters Halm Academy, a boarding school. During this time in which the two of them spend more and more time apart, Bertia`s mother becomes pregnant and it leaves Bertia worried about one thing.
episodes_data.title_es: Un registro de observación del debut en la sociedad de la autoproclamada villana.

episodes_data.title: An Observation Log of a Self-Proclaimed Villainess and Entering School.
episodes_data.description: Time passes and Bertia enrolls at Halm Academy, the same school as Cecil. At the same time, Heronia, the heroine of the otome game, also enrolls there. Wishing for a happy ending for Cecil, Bertia fights to bring the two of them together.
episodes_data.title_es: Un registro de observación de una villana autoproclamada que ingresa a la escuela.

episodes_data.title: An Observation Log of a Self-Proclaimed Villainess and Love's Cupid.
episodes_data.description: In order for Cecil to find happiness with Heronia, avoiding the reverse harem route is essential. For that reason, Bertia has decided to become love`s cupid, pairing Cecil`s personal aide candidates with other noble ladies.
episodes_data.title_es: Un registro de observación de una autoproclamada villana y Cupido del amor.

episodes_data.title: An Observation Log of a Self-Proclaimed Villainess and First Feelings.
episodes_data.description: Heronia grows impatient with the fact that the situation isn`t unfolding according to the proper scenario and her attitude toward Bertia worsens. Since the moment Cecil left to study abroad, the harassment that Bertia faces, presumably spurred by Heronia, escalates by the day.
episodes_data.title_es: Un registro de observación de una villana autoproclamada y sus primeros sentimientos.
